_doc: Blind 2016 CA hospital muni universe for OOS exclusion-screen test (Signal OS honesty/exclusion framework). Identified using contemporary sources dated 2014-2017 (primarily Business Wire press release feeds reproducing Fitch/Moody's/S&P rating actions; Becker's Hospital Review search snippets; CHFFA staff reports; Bond Buyer 2016-2017 coverage).
_methodology_warning: BLIND-TO-OUTCOMES PROTOCOL: Names were selected based on 2014-2017 press releases that documented active CA hospital muni issuance with rating actions as of 2016-12-31. No 2020+ outcome data was used to preferentially include/exclude any name.

ALL rating fields cite the rating disclosed in the most recent contemporary (2014-2017) press release prior to or shortly after 2016-12-31. Where the disclosure was 2015 or earlier with no 2016/2017 superseding action surfaced, the carry-forward is noted in 'notes'.

CONTAMINATION DISCLOSURE — names where I am aware (from prior project work) of post-2016 outcomes: (a) Verity Health filed Ch 11 in Aug 2018 — INCLUDED here because it was already CCC-rated speculative in 2016 and is exactly the kind of distressed sub-IG anchor the user requested; (b) Daughters of Charity Health System was renamed Verity Health Dec 2015 — listed as Verity (the surviving 2016 obligor); (c) St. Joseph Health CA merged into Providence St. Joseph Health July 2016 — INCLUDED at its 2016-AA- rating; (d) Loma Linda's BB+ Apr 2016 rating is contemporary and properly used; (e) Hoag's bonds were refunded into St. Joseph Health's 2014 issue, so the standalone Hoag obligor was no longer outstanding by 2016 — Hoag is therefore subsumed under St. Joseph Health in this list.
I do NOT claim to know which names became distressed 2020-2025; selection logic is purely 2016-rating-distribution based.
Becker's Hospital Review URLs were not directly fetched (403); confirmations come from Google search snippets that quote the rating directly.
Annual revenue figures are 'approximate' — taken from rating-action narrative when available, otherwise from contemporary 2016-2018 Becker's lists or hospital 990s.
in_current_universe flags reflect string-match against the user-provided 2025 universe list; selection did NOT prefer/exclude based on this flag.
